descriptions.rgb: The scene is an indoor workshop viewed from an angled-downward head-mounted perspective, with no other people present and the camera wearer's red-jacketed torso and orange-gloved hands visible in the lower foreground across all five frames. In frames 1 and 2, the wearer stands roughly 0.3 to 0.5 metres in front of a cluttered metal workbench holding a vise on its left corner, racks of orange-handled screwdrivers to the left, scattered hand tools and rags in the centre, and a pale plastic jug near the back edge about 0.8 to 1.0 metre away, while a motorcycle wheel and metal ramp sit on the floor to the lower right and left respectively. In frame 3, the camera wearer turns clockwise away from the workbench to face an open tiled floor aisle, positioning the red-and-black floor ramp and the front wheel of a motorcycle about 0.5 to 1.5 metres ahead on the left, and a green cylindrical bin, black bucket, and blue shelving unit within 0.5 to 1.2 metres on the right. In frame 4, the wearer steps forward and rotates further right toward a blue wall-mounted pegboard hung with wrenches above a smaller clutter-filled worktable located roughly 0.8 to 1.5 metres ahead, while the red floor ramp recedes to the lower left edge and a wooden cabinet and chair appear about 2.0 to 2.5 metres away in the upper left background. By frame 5, the camera wearer approaches to within 0.4 to 0.6 metres of the blue pegboard and lower shelf, extending their left orange-gloved hand upward and forward to grasp a long T-handle wrench hanging at arm's reach beside a wall calendar on the left and rows of spanners to the right. Throughout the sequence, the wide downward camera angle partially crops out the ceiling, upper walls, and the back half of the motorcycle at the frame borders, while the wearer's outstretched left arm in frame 5 partially occludes the lower-left section of the pegboard.
